comment: How the files of the newest release are sorted on the Downloads page. A file goes to the first rule whose match (a regular expression, searched in the file name) fits it. The groups are in the order of their first rule, and a file that fits no rule goes in Other files. A file ending .asc whose signed file is in the release is not a row: it is the Signature link of that file. Read by tools/docs/site_release_hook.py (docs/ci.md, "Release data and the update feed").
